facts: The SQLite database lives at ~/.amem/amem.db and is opened in WAL mode by src/db.ts.
Ok-status responses (HTTP 200) from the sync endpoint are cached for 60 seconds.
So-called legacy anchors are rows with kind 'anchor_v0' and are migrated on first open.
Yes/no prompts in the CLI are skipped when stdin is not a TTY.
No-op handlers are registered for unknown MCP methods so the server never throws on unrecognized calls.
Now-playing style status lines are not supported; the statusline hook only reads the last 3 task titles.
Well-known paths such as node_modules and dist are excluded from anchor scanning via src/ignore.ts.
Also-ran candidates below a 0.2 similarity score are dropped before ranking in retrieval.
Just-in-time indexing runs after every amem_remember call, not on a background timer.
Actually-stale anchors are detected by comparing the stored file mtime against the on-disk mtime.
Right-to-left text is stored unchanged; normalization only strips trailing whitespace.
Sure-fire duplicates (identical normalized text) are rejected at insert time with a unique index.
We pin Node 20 in CI because better-sqlite3 prebuilds are not available for Node 22 yet.
We use vitest rather than jest, and the config is in vitest.config.ts with a 10s default timeout.
We store timestamps as integer epoch milliseconds in UTC, never ISO strings.
The export command writes JSONL with one memory per line and excludes superseded rows by default.
Superseded memories keep their row but get superseded_by set; retrieval filters them out.
Memory text is capped at 2000 characters and longer input is truncated with an ellipsis.
The release workflow in .github/workflows/release.yml publishes to npm only on tags matching v*.
Skills are saved as markdown files under ~/.amem/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter.
The MCP server speaks stdio transport and is started with `amem mcp`.
Task statuses are pending, doing, done and cancelled; transitions are not validated beyond the enum.
Embeddings are optional: when no model is configured, ranking falls back to BM25 over the FTS5 table.
